title: Israel approves West Bank land registration, Palestinians slam ‘de-facto annexation’
summary: Israel's cabinet on Sunday approved a process to register land in the West Bank, a move far-right Finance Minister ​Bezalel Smotrich hailed as "continuing the revolution of settlement". The Palestinian Authority condemned what it called "a ​de-facto annexation of occupied Palestinian territory" and several Arab countries criticised the measure as illegal un…
